explanation:
# Flow Chemistry Design Brief: Two-Stage Photoredox Giese Addition / Aerobic Sulfide Oxidation

---

## (1) Proposed Flow Setup

This is a **two-stage sequential continuous flow system** with distinct anaerobic and aerobic zones.

### Stage 1 — Photoredox Giese Radical Addition (Anaerobic)
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Reactor | KHU PFA coil, 10 mL, 0.75 mm ID |
| Light source | Vapourtec UV-150, 450 nm, 24 W radiant (355 mW/cm²) |
| Temperature | 40 °C |
| Residence time | 19.4 min |
| Flow rate | 0.2077 mL/min |
| Atmosphere | Argon (pre-degassed feed) |

**Feed preparation (Stream A):** Dissolve PMPSCH2TMS (1.0 equiv, 0.1 M), acrylonitrile (2.0 equiv, 0.2 M), and Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)₂(dtbpy)PF₆ (0.5 mol%) in EtOH/pH 9 aqueous buffer (5:1 v/v). Sparge with argon for ≥20 min offline. Load into sealed syringes under argon blanket. Flush the Stage 1 reactor with argon-purged solvent before starting the run.

### Stage 2 — Photocatalytic Aerobic Sulfide Oxidation
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Reactor | KHU FEP coil, 20 mL, 0.75 mm ID |
| Light source | KHU manual blue photoreactor, 448 nm, 62 mW/cm² |
| Temperature | 40–50 °C |
| O₂ introduction | T-junction at Stage 1 outlet; KHU MFC at **0.4655 sccm** (0.1347 mL/min actual at 4.0 bar abs) |
| Back-pressure | 3.0 bar (manual needle valve — see warnings) |

**Connector:** T-mixer between Stage 1 outlet and O₂ MFC. The O₂ enters as segmented gas-liquid flow into the Stage 2 coil.

**Total liquid reactor volume:** 30 mL. Combined gas holdup in Stage 2: ε_g = 0.39. Overall liquid-phase residence time: ~60 min (20 min Stage 1 + ~40 min Stage 2).

**Outlet:** Collect directly; vent excess O₂ before workup. No chemical quench required.

---

## (2) Why These Conditions Were Chosen

### Residence time — 19.4 min (Stage 1)
Three literature analogies were used:

- **10.1039/c9re00451c** — Ir-photoredox Giese radical addition in flow, 30 min residence time, 48× batch-to-flow time reduction. Directly supports the feasibility of sub-30 min flow residence times for this mechanism class.
- **10.1039/d0re00440e** — Vapourtec UV-150 at 450 nm with Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)₂-class photocatalyst, 40 min residence time for a comparable photoredox C–C coupling. Most directly applicable: same hardware, same catalyst family, same wavelength.
- **10.1039/d1re00289a** — Analogous photocatalytic aerobic oxidation with O₂ segmented flow; supports Stage 2 residence time allocation.

The class-average intensification factor for photoredox is 6×; the design mandate required 20× (driven by the dual batch limitations of photon penetration and gas–liquid mass transfer). With available inventory coils totalling 30 mL and Q = 0.2077 mL/min liquid, total liquid τ = ~60 min, which falls within the calculated range of 9.5–150 min.

### Temperature — 40 °C
The Vapourtec UV-150 has a hard minimum operating temperature of 40 °C. Batch protocol runs at 25 °C. The 15 °C increase is expected to modestly accelerate both steps; selectivity impact should be verified experimentally.

### Wavelength — 450 nm
Ir(dF(CF3)ppy)₂(dtbpy)PF₆ has its MLCT absorption band at 380–450 nm. Batch used 452 nm. The UV-150 450 nm module is the closest available spectral match and delivers 2.4× the radiant power of the batch 10 W lamp (24 W vs. ~10 W). The KHU manual reactor at 448 nm covers Stage 2.

### Concentration — 0.1 M
Taken directly from the batch protocol. This is within the normal range for photoredox flow chemistry. Inner-filter analysis using ε ≈ 2000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ at 0.1 M in 0.75 mm ID tubing gives A ≈ 15 — high but operationally manageable in a thin-channel PFA coil wrapped tightly around the LED array, where the effective illumination geometry is annular rather than transmissive. **Note:** a minority assessment within the design council used ε = 8000 M⁻¹cm⁻¹ (flagged as implausibly high by the audit — see Section 4).

### O₂ flow — 0.4655 sccm
Stoichiometrically delivers 1.0 equiv O₂ relative to the sulfide intermediate at the liquid flow rate of 0.2077 mL/min. The calculated mass transfer coefficient k_L·a = 0.158 s⁻¹ in segmented flow gives an O₂ transfer capacity 89.7× the O₂ consumption rate — mass transfer is not limiting under these conditions.

### Tubing — PFA (Stage 1) / FE

**Confidence: MEDIUM** — Best analogy score: 0.56. A related literature precedent was found but conditions differ. Validate key parameters (residence time, concentration) experimentally.

Final engineering validation: ready.

Final design disposition: BLOCK. Blocked by 3 deterministic hard-feasibility failure(s); do not execute the proposed experiment.

mechanism_steps.description: Photoexcitation of Ir(III) ground state to Ir(III)* excited state by 450 nm photon absorption (MLCT band)

The reaction was performed in DMSO solvent at 25°C using a MiChS flow photoreactor L-1 (M) with 2 mm ID quartz tubing and a 2.7 mL reactor volume.
